transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello, do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have some questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can go back to light exercise, like gardening, after 1 week. Try to avoid heavy lifting or strenuous work for a month. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for that information. When can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise. If you’re running low, your GP should be able to provide more. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I appreciate it. I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended: Mild light sensitivity can be normal while your eye adjusts, and wearing sunglasses outside can help. But if the light sensitivity is strong, or if the eye is red and painful too, that is not normal and may need checking. Do you have any other questions?
